status: bounded topic screen; not an inference protocol
question: Does a real intermediate representation lose task-relevant relations in a way distinct from known entity-binding, provenance, or semantic-formalization errors?

source.kind: public simulated tasks, not observed customer interactions

selection.rule: Inspect the first three task IDs in numeric ascending order in each of retail and airline. All source IDs are integer strings. Inspect eligibility and retain exclusions; do not replace a rejected case with a later ID.
eligibility: A named or resolvable action target with related attributes or records
A relation can matter to a specific action or clearly bounded policy predicate
Complete source task and policy can be inspected
User-private intent and evaluator answers can be separated from agent-available information
selection.exposure: Task 0 in each family was read to inspect the schema before this specification was saved. No model results were used for selection; no blind or prospective human review is claimed.

scope: No benchmark generation, API calls, training, human-label fabrication, application of the retrospective patch, git commit, push, fork, or publication. Paper code is read as source, not executed.
